notes.title: Big fat update: more resources, even more research and 2 new languages
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, ReFactory team’s online!

We are proud to announce that a new ReFactory update  is now available for our fans! This is a huge one, and we could not have done it without everyone's great feedback.

This update is a big step forward in making the game more fun and welcoming to all players, with over 50 improvements and new features. We also added the ability to get water from new sources and a pile of new resources to discover.


In addition, AI 'Synthie' is able to speak German and Spanish.


Now, let’s dive into details about changes in the ReFactory update. Ready! Steady! Go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/990cf2be369ba582efefd60fcfea728a1953a61b.png

Technological breakthrough!

In today's update, we're introducing an unprecedented ingame technological leap.
There is so much new research that it is worth talking about each one separately.

New research "Synthetic oil"

The "Synthetic Oil" research allows you to create resources in the Laboratory. This is the perfect way you can get out of a difficult situation when the oil field is empty! However, this is not a panacea. You won't be able to rely on Synthetic Oil exclusively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/2167ebd4c6c8ae888a0e5fe7f47671360b8958e4.png

New research  "Building yard"

Now the research "Building yard lvl.2" and "Building yard lvl.3" are available in the game, they will increase the service area.
Drones can now operate over a wider area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/d86714aa156a15af3135a64573ad14af1086e7f7.png

New research “Logistics”

"Logistics lvl. 2" will allow you to build a new object - the Merger. Now you can evenly merge resource flows from three tapes into one without any downtime!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/cca4e35b12184efea43a17d634588d24e21115e6.png

"Logistics Lv.3" will add 4 more squares to the maximum length of the Underground Conveyor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/5fdd7ff8217bf95a05f8627fc5fb0ee7a50f47c0.png

"Logistics lvl. 4" will give you an unprecedented opportunity to build a Conveyor directly on top of trees and crystals! You can not only place the Saw Machine right in the center of a field of crystals or a forest, but also give them the desired shape yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/2a5aad23a017f8b8ee9bdc16441faf497cac09b8.png

New research "Economical Weapons"

2 levels of this research are aimed at reducing the energy consumption of all weapons during the battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/8175f2cc497f7a08d461f88166675174df746ae0.png

New research  "Smelting"

"Smelting Lv.2" and "Smelting Lv.3" will unlock additional recipes for Silicon Wafers and Building slabs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/b02cbb8880c760ad0ad6b4cb22d410b9d962cf3b.png

New research "Irrigation 3"

"Irrigation lvl.3" will open a new resource - Feed Water. It can be loaded into Sprinkler. Such watering accelerates the growth of trees and crystals by 2 times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/c112c6268c7f34c759e33e6b05e4492fc9b2faa0.png

Nanotechnology and infinity!

Now the “Custom Game” mode has the ability to be truly endless!

A total of 17 infinite researches are available in the new Nano research category! Yes, yes, you can upgrade them to at least level 1000!

These studies with each level give a small pumping of the game parameters that the player needs most at the current stage of base development. But the cost of each new level will increase…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/9f1bb83c3aaeda8a0f8be335192dc989cf1a8b11.png

In addition to these researches, of course, there are as many as 6 new resources and a new building - Nano printer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/4a29b265f69dbcbe600aa7b3f6338a248866d6fc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/ec08b977646a9da36cb864c35ec249646e6f6f4b.png

Map editor

The new "Map Editing Mode" allows you to load any "Custom Game" save and edit it as you wish: add / remove resources / objects / monsters or remove everything and create a unique map to your taste!


Don't forget to show off your masterpieces!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/f53f994a22a6dc5cb58dc169523359f1aad3694f.png

Rich deposits are even bigger now!

Deposits and lakes set to "rich" now have 999,999,999 resources!
This will work even on old saves! The exhausted deposits and lakes have refilled!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/ed934c4708373bc03b8a0cc283d4f82825aff53f.png

Close connection between meteorites and lakes

Now meteorites are no longer just a natural disaster. In this update, when the meteorite fell and formed a funnel, then with a small chance a new source of water appeared there  - "Crater lake". Have you ever expected this?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/34ca92cd5705c2eca046259975b9d77dd6f78c72.png

Campaign Difficulty Setting

You have been asking us for this for a long time, and we have finally implemented this idea! Now you can choose a comfortable difficulty level at the start of any mission.

You can edit: 
—The number and strength of monsters in the night waves
— Monster evolution rate
— Frequency of meteorite falls

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/38340abe6b0489c9cc8c8676ad4a6efe101f57c7.png

Analyze it! More statistics

We have added the ability to view the statistics of your base at any stage of the game. More data for the God of Data!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/eab0091795fafc13d0a3c65e21b60654fb427367.png

Previously, the statistical table was displayed by default to the player at the end of a mission or an important stage of the game, but now the analytics are available by clicking without leaving the main menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/eab0091795fafc13d0a3c65e21b60654fb427367.png

New features of the T-satellite

The T-Satellite will find the Destroyed Ooze Generator. This ability will be unlocked by unlocking the corresponding research.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/56ee57195c19de2c9bbd9a15a4298501b5df088a.png

Players have hinted to our team a lot about difficulties with finding the Destroyed Ooze Generator. Now it's in the bag!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/e72ca3e82aba361e55aa33d963e50c88401f75e9.png

Any building level on click

We set out to make it easier to build (and rebuild) the base for everyone who was waiting for this revision. No sooner said than done!

Now in the construction mode, you can select and build a building of any of the levels available to the player. You just have to choose: lvl.1, lvl.2 or lvl.3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/ea99ba3eaa0bee09a93840ba5f4f795ff0e91962.png

Quick Save

We've added a super quick save option without the need for extra clicks!

You can now save and load the game by clicking:
Shift+F2 - quick save with a separate name
F9 - Quick Save Fast Load 

Nice skill changes

1.Skills to increase work speed of all mining and production buildings now provide 20% haste (instead of 10% as it was before).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/24a812fbcb8cc7a83323a0409096895624e802c3.png

2. Skills to accelerate research gives 25% acceleration (instead of 10% as it was before).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/8dbe896633af7b6bb10ffd22360b37a55b007582.png

2 new languages

Now Synthie will speak not only Russian and English. Full professional translation into German and Spanish - in action!

We dreamed of making ReFactory more understandable and native to a larger number of players and expand the audience of the game. We are getting closer to our dreams!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/d3d75abdf9a13e7135fbbad47de47f498b2bdf0f.jpg

We're really excited to share this update with you! We hope you enjoy it as much as we do. Thanks for being such a great community—we couldn't have done this without your support.

We are waiting for any bugs you found in Discord. And always appreciate feedback!

notes.title: The long-awaited update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, ReFactory team’s online!

Welcome a small, but important update of ReFactory. We’ve implemented the long-awaited ideas of creating megafactories! Of course, those ideas are yours :)

There are new features in this version:
[olist]
 Changing the area of work of industrial buildings
 Growing your own plantations of Forests and Crystals
 Cutting off the electricity supply to the cannons (and turning it on again at will!)
[/olist]
Sounds nice, huh? Now, for more details about changes in the ReFactory update. Let’s roll!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/ad99f0b5a6858bd4930ac5e41f6aeb78d1c687b8.png

Irrigation and new garden plantations

Now we are not predatory consumers of the planet’s non-renewable resources, but the real lords over Forests and Crystals. “Fertilize, irrigate, get bonuses for housekeeping!” — this is the green motto of the update.

Opening the “Irrigation lvl. 2” tech grants an opportunity to become the owner of plantations of Forests and Crystals.

‘Sprinkler’ tech has been renamed to “Irrigation lvl.1” and now has 2 upgrade levels.

— The first level is a normal Sprinkler

— The second level unlocks a new resource: “Fertilizer”, which makes it possible to grow your own garden on an unknown planet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/52d903632518dfdcc980ba49e524df80a08797ed.png

There are 3 features regarding crystal and plant growing that are important to consider.

First, You can only place your plantation next to the source resource.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/a921695becc0ad69db24c82deba708f282189c0e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/2814e41002f4930c06eb39eec2228c476eb8a8fa.png

Second, There are only 80 cells at your disposal. Making the field infinite won’t work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/6a45171a66874cb08683f18be03f084d1813ac4a.png

Third, Without watering, seedlings will not turn into a full-fledged Crystal or Forest plantation, rich in resources. No pain, no gain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/9a1db1d765d09ac081ab53ddc1974c6a11d9e824.png

It’s just like life, isn’t it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/1bedea3bc0457320f9fac1c79ebe7c319d14f851.png

A good U-turn is what you need!

We’ve added a “Change direction” button for the production buildings. It’s not a joke, now you can set the direction of the flow of resources back and forth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/b41b6d570b88c8c673325fda632553fa946c0f9a.png

The players repeatedly asked for this idea to be implemented, and the Refractory team heard them. Well, you can’t just … mirror the building!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/ad66139c8e5457e472cbf6301db0964998928c97.png

Now the “Change direction” button solves the problem of complicated production lines and gives more opportunities for organizing the base.

So, now you can twist ’em any way you like!

ON/OFF button for Cannons

The combat equipment of the base requires a lot of resources. And when the Cannons are idle, they continue to consume energy you might’ve planned to use for something else.

Now you can ‘pause’ their energy consumption. It’s a case of ‘A penny saved is a penny earned.’

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/5d2fe2a2d8336a70d1b45648b96c9f0709d6eea1.png

Cargo stations limits

Now you can specify loud and clear the amount and the type of resource that should be delivered to a particular Cargo station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/d1c5454bc637639b6435bb41f2266d5d0cce46f0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/18faabf73bd6150602f208b89160445eec1fff47.png

New overlays

When the Sprinkler is selected, the areas of action for all the nearest ones are visible.

The same, for the Drainer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/c34dadde5e0691a61b95f1714296fe080aa8490d.png

New Puzzle

Time to use the sharpness of your mind, solving a fresh and rather difficult task.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/290819c92766d9c0babcd9a4f89a698a67da33e8.png

Other fixes

[olist]
 In the first mission there are now more objects with resources that can be dismantled and used for development of the base.

 Wind turbines can no longer be built at the foot of hills. To convert wind into energy, you will have to place it on a hill.

 We fixed an unfortunate mistake, where canceling the repair of a destroyed building removed it entirely. Everything’s fine now!

 The situation where resources located on the ground could be affected by an air defense shot at an approaching meteorite was completely eliminated.

 Other minor fixes.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/a704c71fc04792d1667dfff2b82a3f6bd52494ad.png

First we like to thank you all for your support and feedback over the last months. Keep it coming, please know that we are reading all posts, discussions and suggestions.

We are waiting for any bugs you found in Discord. Always appreciate feedback!


ReFactory team

notes.title: New Year’s Eve update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, ReFactory team’s  online!

This update brings Transport! Now you can use trucks to carry cargo to the most distant places. Pulling the conveyor belt through the whole map is now just a memory. Also we’ve improved the building system to make it more convenient, and upgraded Auto Save.

Now, for more details about changes in the ReFactory update. Let’s roll!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/dc0cb2724af48dd31582019195a99a9a5cfb7472.png

Finally, Transport!

For quite a long time, players asked us to solve the problem of pulling the conveyor belts beyond the horizon, hundreds of kilometers from the base to the source of the required resource. We’ve come up with a thoroughly prepared solution — Transport in ReFactory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/35ddfa4c47a415f171a94b74b8c8b57c6e3dda3d.png

A brief update on it:

— New techs and resources related to Transport have appeared;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/fbb503355bc07ea65544a5cec545775c0a82ed17.png

— Our vehicle is a Truck. It can be made at the Auto Plant;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/7958e8e2262d993a2e802e4c884927ad9ecf1fb4.png

— Trucks carry resources between two Cargo Stations at any distance. You don’t have to pull conveyors to remote parts of the map anymore;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/a2ea7f6dfbf9fa86974c5f061061fd8f903127b9.png

— Trucks pass through any obstacle: wood, rocks, crystals or any building. Except for lakes: they can’t dive or swim.

— There are two types of Cargo Stations: Small (x1) and Large (x4). You must have at least two stations to organize the transportation system. Or more, if necessary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/930f5f6dc78758cd714877fa2b0cffbf420258e8.png

— To transport the resource, you need to organize its delivery to the Cargo Station, as well as to build Containers in the receiving station.

— There is a Building yard nearby when deploying the Cargo station. It makes building in remote areas quicker and more convenient.

Holiday discount 

On New Year’s, Steam players may buy  ReFactory with 40% discount. 

Auto Save upgrade

We added the opportunity to save different variants of Puzzle solutions. Now there will be no more cases when autosaving of the Puzzle rewrites the save file of your main mission.

More informative Wind Turbines

Now you can check the wind force in the Wind Turbine information window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/9d3a39578981c906c597050eea0002081a06feda.png

Upgrades for even more convenient building

— Rotation of the group of constructions in the building mode;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/f6c63db48c82ab6a912cef84eab691ba551ee563.png

— Improving the selected group of identical buildings simultaneously, literally in one click!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/c86868eb2aba685910e9d1116323b71f27a4c2bd.png

— A hotkey to build the selected object in the planning mode. Less clicks, more convenient buttons! Simply press E or Enter while building, and your development plan is agreed;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/b2b4646ca2878d22add7f8dc32e35250d92d2f73.png

— Setting hotkeys during the game. Now in Settings there is a tab called “Hotkeys” (the only way to do that before was from the Main Menu).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/3158cdc67ae0e671f14bbb8ac0c36629ec827559.png

Fixing Display Area of Building Activity

Displaying the area of action of a group of objects was brighter, the more of them are selected.
We have removed excessive brightness, but kept it visually informative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/30d8f1fd17822cdbc824bd303535ed2ba8a0646c.png

Other fixes

[olist]
 Cancelling the research drone’s current mission if it is damaged;

 Fixed an unfortunate error that led to the failure of the conveyor belts. Everything is fine now!

 Completely eliminated a situation where a construction drone hangs over the Container for a long time. It was a mistake that needed to be fixed;

 Other minor fixes.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41355848/c399cf7543b9637114600993fba4782ed42f7827.jpg

We are waiting for any bugs you found in Discord 
We always appreciate feedback!

notes.title: Update v.1.7
notes.notes:
Main changes and additions:

 Cloud savings: you can combine different accounts into one
 More customization options for "Custom game" 
 Indication of disassembled objects 
 Switchable Splitter
 Problem construction area is highlighted
 Trees move when the wind blows 
 Visual fix: generation of rocks and crystals changed
 More resources in the tutorial mission


Other minor fixes.

Full patch notes: ​​https://bit.ly/3Djxilc
